exit.gas: 400000 gas × baseFee 0.12 gwei (block #26162868) × ETH $2,510 (ENS eth-usd.data.eth → 0x5f4eC3Df9cbd43714FE2740f5E3616155c5b8419 (Registry 0x00000000000C2E074eC69A0dFb2997BA6C7d2e1e → resolver 0x122eb74f9d0F1a5ed587F43D120C1c2BbDb9360B) #26162868)
exit.note: beyond f_max, the exit depends on borrowers repaying / on rates rising

decision.sentence: STAY — exiting (only 22% can be exited now) would avoid $153 of expected loss over the horizon, but would cost $643. Exit if you put the risk "mGLOeuro collateral drop" above 0.6% (≈ once every 3 years) (our estimate: 0.10%, i.e. ≈ once every 20 years).

incidents.title: mGLOeuro collateral drop
incidents.rule: sudden shock on a collateral whose oracle does NOT follow the market (internal rate / set price): no timely liquidation → bad debt max(0, D − V·(1−d)·(1−slippage)), borrower by borrower
incidents.contagion_path: morpho_vault_v2:0x… → [deployed_in] Belem RWA EURCV → [deployed_in] Morpho Blue mGLOeuro / EURCV (LLTV 77.0%) → [collateralized_by] mGLOeuro

incidents.title: EURCV depeg (pocket asset)
incidents.rule: the pocket is denominated in this asset: loss = value × d
